items.title: The FCC approves Amazon Leo’s $11.5 billion Globalstar acquisition.
items.excerpt: The deal was announced in April and is expected to close in 2027. It gives Amazon Globalstar’s constellation of 25 satellites and its spectrum — a welcome boost given its stalled launch timeline — and means Leo will now power the satellite services for Apple’s supported iPhones and Apple Watches. [Link: FCC Approves Amazon Leo’s Acquisition of Globalstar | https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DOC-426214A1.pdf | The Federal Communications Commission]
